title: Rabbi Yehudah the Tailor

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Rabbi’s student and an expert scribe. In the episode he cites from [Bava Batra 164b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.164b.13-14), Yehudah wrote a Psalms scroll for Rabbi. On seeing it, Rabbi said, “How fine and straight this writing is!” His son Rabbi Shimon told him that Rabbi Yehudah the Tailor had written it.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Chayata means “the Tailor.” Rabbi’s son Shimon identifies the scribe; he is not described as the scribe’s son.

In the linked Bavli, Rabbi’s son Shimon names Yehudah the Tailor when Rabbi asks about a document. The next exchange concerns the Psalms scroll and repeats the identification. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1657&lang=en) discusses both the attribution and Rabbi’s warning about harmful speech.
